plugins.name: groundwork
plugins.description: Guided Claude Code setup: verified AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and skills, with a short 'why' lesson on every choice.

plugins.name: agent-ops
plugins.description: Run agents as a disciplined loop: plan, verify, reflect, budget, route handoffs, and learn from failures.

plugins.name: ai-engineering
plugins.description: Build LLM-powered product features that hold up: evals, prompts, RAG, tool schemas, guardrails, cost, and context design.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Map, protect, and evolve the structure of a codebase: modules, dependencies, boundaries, interfaces, data models, and migrations.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Focused review lenses for diffs and PRs: each agent checks one concern and returns file:line findings with severity.

plugins.name: devops
plugins.description: Keep CI green and fast, ship releases safely, and run production with good configs, containers, observability, and cost control.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Keep project knowledge accurate and findable: READMEs, API docs, onboarding, changelogs, diagrams, and drift checks.

plugins.name: explainable-ai
plugins.description: Make agent work and AI features explainable: why a change was made, what proves it, which assumptions, how confident, and what was rejected.

plugins.name: quality
plugins.description: Test strategy and test writing: find gaps, kill flakes, lock regressions, and prove tests actually catch bugs.

plugins.name: risk-reward
plugins.description: Weigh the risk of a change against its reward before shipping: explicit risk scores, blast radius, reversibility, rollback plans, and go/no-go gates.

plugins.name: safety
plugins.description: Defensive safety for AI coding agents and what they build: secrets, dangerous commands, least-privilege permissions, prompt injection, PII, licenses, and supply chain.

plugins.name: token-economy
plugins.description: Spend fewer tokens per task without losing correctness: narrow reads, cache-friendly prompts, compact diffs, logs and outputs, and cheaper models where they are good enough.
